pretexts: unsolicited requests for personal and financial information

kill_chain_signals.contact: unsolicited emails, phone calls, mail requesting personal and financial information
kill_chain_signals.pretext: fraudsters use stolen personal information to apply for government benefits, open credit cards and bank accounts, take over social media and email accounts
kill_chain_signals.payment: not applicable - fraudsters open unauthorized accounts rather than requesting direct payment
kill_chain_signals.movement: unauthorized applications or accounts showing up on credit report
kill_chain_signals.cashout: open credit cards and bank accounts, apply for government benefits, create unauthorized cell phone accounts

red_flags: Missing bills or receiving bills from services providers you do not use
Unfamiliar transactions in your bank account or credit card statements
Letters regarding credit applications you did not submit
Unauthorized applications or accounts showing up on your credit report
Calls from creditors or collection agencies regarding accounts you did not open
key_quote: Fraudsters increasingly use stolen personal information to apply for government benefits, open credit cards and bank accounts, take over social medial and email accounts.
title: Identity fraud
